title: RocketRo's CreateCraft
description: All-in-one ultimate Create modpack! Make anything you can imagine and much more!
body:
### VERY EARLY ALPHA! MAY CRASH A LOT!

# **CREATECRAFT**

## _All the best Create mods and more._



Do you want to ride in a tank, blast a dinosaur, drive it into a plane that goes into an underwater submarine that also turns into a **ROCKET**!?

_crickets_

Well I do! This modpack adds a ton of things for immersion and graphics and shaders and features and... **ROCKETS**! I like rockets. A lot.

And all of these vehicles are MULTIBLOCK. This means they are actually made and controlled by YOU. Want to make an underwater pressurised mobile cake factory? Why not!?

And if making rediculously cool stuff isn't your thing, then we still got something! Farmers Delight for food, Alex's Mobs for... mobs! Terralith, Tectonic and Biomes O' Plenty for terrain and let's not for get all the optimisation mods to even make it run well on my potato!

**_Please note this modpack will likely change a lot and is in a very early state. It is made for survival (or creative) but some parts of certain mods like Starlance aren't fully survival-compatible yet._**
